items.name: portfolio-v1
items.title: Portfolio v1
items.description: Next.js starter for a physicist and science communicator portfolio: writing, books, Saturn decoration, and a Basin contact form. New projects only (shadcn init --template next).
items.docs:
New Next.js project only (same flow as https://ui.shadcn.com/create):
  npx shadcn@latest init --template next -y "https://uiception.com/r/portfolio-v1.json"

This scaffolds Next.js + shadcn, then installs the full site (app routes, content, components).

Then set BASIN_ENDPOINT in .env.local. Edit your name/bio/social links in app/page.tsx and app/layout.tsx. Writing posts live in content/writing/*.mdx and books live in content/books/*.mdx. MDX supports GFM tables and LaTeX math ($inline$ / $$block$$) via remark-gfm, remark-math, and rehype-katex.

items.name: portfolio-v2

items.description: Static personal portfolio for a fullstack developer — notes, fictional projects, and experience. Typed TypeScript content — no CMS, no markdown. New projects only (shadcn init --template next).
items.docs:
New Next.js project only (same flow as https://ui.shadcn.com/create):
  npx shadcn@latest init --template next -y "https://uiception.com/r/portfolio-v2.json"

This scaffolds Next.js + shadcn, then installs the full site.

To personalize: attach your resume and point your coding agent at AGENTS.md — it re-skins the whole site (name, bio, links, notes, projects, experience) and runs the UNSLOP.md pass on the prose it writes. Or edit app/page.tsx directly. Drop a photo at public/avatar.png to replace the JD initials. The email link copies jefferyspippitt@gmail.com (edit components/copy-email.tsx). Notes live in lib/notes.tsx as typed React bodies — no markdown or CMS. Preview at /view/portfolio-v2. Press D to toggle theme.

Canvas UI Liquid: trails work everywhere. Text distortion needs Chromium html-in-canvas. Register one Origin Trial token for your production origin at https://developer.chrome.com/origintrials (html-in-canvas), then set NEXT_PUBLIC_HTML_IN_CANVAS_OT_TOKEN in .env.local. Local-only warp without a token: chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element.

items.name: portfolio-v3
items.title: Portfolio v3
items.description: Scroll-scrubbed lifeline timeline for a fullstack developer — Jon Doe filler career with fictional companies. Drop images and videos into public/ slots. New projects only (shadcn init --template next).
items.docs:
New Next.js project only (same flow as https://ui.shadcn.com/create):
  npx shadcn@latest init --template next -y "https://uiception.com/r/portfolio-v3.json"

This scaffolds Next.js + shadcn, then installs the full timeline site.

Edit milestones, global events, and companies in lib/jon-doe.ts. Four color-coded tracks: set an event's `category` to "work", "college", or "destination" for an amber/violet/teal timeline dot, and list conference/meetup entries under a milestone's `globalEvents` for a pink dot with a company icon. Drop moment stills into public/images/moments/, destination photos into public/images/destinations/, and clips into public/videos/moments/ (matching the .gitkeep names). Destination events also accept a `video` filename under public/videos/destinations/. Fresh install uses the same local-first + CDN fallback as blocks (https://uiception.com/images|videos/templates/portfolio-v3/...). A local file with the same base name wins. Drop public/avatar.png to replace the demo avatar. Preview at /view/portfolio-v3. Theme switcher is in the footer.

Lifeline components are vendored from https://github.com/evilrabbit/lifeline (MIT).

items.name: landing-page-v1
items.title: Landing Page v1
items.description: Fullscreen startup waitlist — monochrome ink-print hero with a boiling misregistered display title and floating hex-tile cursor effect on the left, Clerk's <Waitlist /> component (shadcn theme) on the right. Palette in app/globals.css; layout and type via Tailwind on the page. Renders a keyless demo form until Clerk keys are set. New projects only (shadcn init --template next).
items.docs:
New Next.js project only (same flow as https://ui.shadcn.com/create):
  npx shadcn@latest init --template next -y "https://uiception.com/r/landing-page-v1.json"

This scaffolds Next.js + shadcn, then installs the full site.

Clerk setup — fastest path is the Clerk CLI (https://clerk.com/docs/cli):
  npx clerk init -y
This links (or creates) a Clerk app and writes both keys to .env.local — no dashboard copy-paste. Alternatively, copy the keys from https://dashboard.clerk.com/~/api-keys into .env.local (see .env.example).

Then enable Waitlist mode: Clerk Dashboard → Waitlist → toggle "Enable waitlist".

<Waitlist /> submits to Clerk's Frontend API; entries show in the Dashboard. app/api/webhooks/route.ts verifies waitlistEntry.created / waitlistEntry.updated (add side effects there). Local test:
  clerk webhooks listen --forward-to http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks
Add the printed relay URL as a Dashboard webhook endpoint (subscribe to waitlistEntry.*), set CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET from that endpoint, restart the app, then join the waitlist.

Until keys are set, the page renders a local demo form that stores nothing. The <Waitlist /> component is mounted on the home page, so waitlistUrl is "/" (set on ClerkProvider in app/layout.tsx). The shadcn theme comes from @clerk/ui/themes and its CSS is imported in app/globals.css.

Edit all page copy (name, tagline, footer links) in lib/site.ts.
